published_prior_art.cite: Pollard1982Central and Levrard2015 establish fixed-level quantizer geometry, but not this causal witness-membership package.
KimKimKennedy2026 supplies fixed-target causal k-means inference; LiuPages2020 studies empirical optimal-quantization performance, neither gives the adjacent efficient-score arithmetic covariance.

LiuPages2020 gives optimal-quantizer/performance convergence and CCK/Belloni supply generic high-dimensional machinery, not a uniform causal reoptimization expansion relative to shrinking adjacent score scales.
Levrard2015 gives a fixed-level quantization lower-bound construction, not an observed-data causal score-aligned multi-resolution Fano family.

KimKimKennedy2026, LiuPages2020, BelloniChernozhukovChetverikovWei2018, and ChernozhukovChetverikovKato2017 do not provide a matched simultaneous-band radius over this reoptimized causal local experiment.
The uniform distortion identity is classical, but no checked cited result gives the adjacent causal-score noise/geometric phase transition.
KimKimWassermanKennedy2024 studies hierarchical and density-based causal clustering, not intrinsic simultaneous complexity of adjacent optimized distortions.

novelty_flags.label: Theorems 2–4 / related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: LiuPages2020 is a closer omitted published comparator: it directly analyzes convergence of empirical optimal quantizers and distortion performance with quantization-level dependence, so the proposal must distinguish its growing-resolution stability results from the new joint causal-score band and Fano frontier.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:matched-width-frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The matched upper/lower theorem is local to the explicit experiment U_n and conditional on sup_{P in U_n} Xi_n(P) tending to zero; it is not a minimax theorem over all of P_n^CQ.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Gaussian-width-optimal simultaneous rectangular-band radius over U_n, conditional on the displayed primitive remainder/approximation condition.

source_verification_receipts.version: JRSSB advance journal article, published 27 April 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The abstract states that causal k-means clusters unknown counterfactual functions and that its bias-corrected semiparametric/DML estimator attains fast root-n rates and asymptotic normality in large nonparametric models.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 43 (2015) journal typeset PDF
source_verification_receipts.locator: Definition 2.1 and Proposition 2.2, pages 6–8; Theorem 3.1, page 9; Proposition 3.1, pages 11–12
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a quantization margin condition, derives local quadratic growth consequences, proves an empirical-risk upper bound, and gives a minimax lower bound for quantizer excess distortion.
The abstract develops simultaneous confidence bands for many potentially functional Z-estimation parameters using approximately Neyman-orthogonal scores and high-dimensional uniform CLTs.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v4 corresponding to the cited 2017 Annals of Probability article
source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract, lines 16–18; high-dimensional hyperrectangle and bootstrap theorem sections
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work gives Gaussian and bootstrap approximations for sums of high-dimensional independent centered vectors over hyperrectangles, including dimensions growing with n.
The manuscript gives nearly optimal Gaussian and multiplier/empirical-bootstrap bounds for nondegenerate high-dimensional covariance structures.
The article develops lower bounds for expected length of honest adaptive confidence intervals for linear functionals.

The paper extends causal clustering to hierarchical and density-based clustering and studies plug-in estimators under minimal regularity; it is not an optimized-distortion resolution-profile inference result.

The paper studies convergence of optimal K-level quantizers and distortion performance for probability-measure sequences, including empirical measures, and reports bounds with quantization-level dependence.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Liu and Pagès (2020) to the bibliography and related-work discussion, then state precisely why its optimal-quantizer/performance convergence does not control the joint adjacent efficient-score covariance, multiplier calibration, or causal Fano lower bound.

For the uniform witness, derive a transparent sufficient growth envelope for K_n and r_n from Xi_n→0 rather than leaving the flagship condition only as the composite gauge; report which component binds in the noiseless and noise-dominated regimes.

Extend the matched lower bound from the uniform randomized-trial tilt neighborhood to a nonuniform, heteroskedastic subclass with explicit observable density/residual conditions, thereby resolving a substantive portion of the stated OEQ.

recommended_next_step: Revise the literature survey around LiuPages2020 and add an explicit non-overlap comparison before advancing this otherwise flagship-grade local matched-frontier target.
